label: Tutorial: Bundles
description: Steps of the Tutorial button on the Bundles page (endpoint bundle.list). A step: target (CSS selector, empty = centred card), title, text (blank line = new paragraph, **bold**, `code`), roles (optional: anonymous, user, member, admin, perm:<key>), demo (rule / bundle: example shown when the target is missing, e.g. an empty list).

steps.title: Bundles
steps.text: A bundle groups rules of any format around one subject: a threat actor, a CVE, a malware family, a customer, a training. Download it in one zip, follow its releases, push it to MISP.

steps.title: Every bundle, or yours
steps.text: **All bundles**: the public ones. **Mine**: the bundles you own, public or private. **Favorites**: the ones you starred (loaded the first time you open the tab).

steps.title: The list
steps.text: Search and filter the bundles. Each card shows the number of rules, the formats inside, tags, votes and author — open one to see its rules, structure and history.
